scope: Complete preserved official job union + reviewed local improvements/observations + explicit candidate inventory cut; CPU-only rendering
methodology: Union preserved API captures by job ID to survive latest50 pagination; newest observed row wins. Append explicitly labeled accepted-receipt plus own-result rows where no newer API capture exists; do not invent captures. Mode=run determines leaderboard submissions; checks remain separate including failures/noarchive.
Candidate inventory is an explicit preserved source-directory cut; new in-progress directories do not alter frozen history until deliberately appended. All source files remain on disk/ROI.
Stable job/candidate/improvement/observation IDs; every input/source/raw/review link carries SHA256 when locally present.
Source compiled/available features are distinct from actual per-job selected policies and timed profiles.
No independent-job score subtraction is reported as a causal feature delta.
Feature findings and repeated positive preparation observations are separate tables; no positive threshold removes small observations.
Keep invalid attempts and superseded parents immutable; repairs get new source or attempt identity.
Review provenance gaps explicitly; server content_hash algorithm unknown and not raw SHA256 attestation.

components.name: Lossless 12-bit BF16 codec with escapes
components.status: SOURCE_PRESENT; actual applicability is in scored routes
components.implementation: 8-bit low byte plus sign and 3-bit high-byte window delta; choose densest window; XOR escaped high bits restore outliers. Independent unpack verifies all packed weights; per-warp fixed-stride sorted sentinel escape lists.
components.gain_scope: Exact source inclusion and scored package validation; no isolated component causal gain inferred.
